title: Geologic Map of the Magnolia Beach Quadrangle, Georgetown County, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2012, Geologic Map of the Magnolia Beach Quadrangle, Georgetown County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-185, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet; map face is noise. Units here are grouped by terrace (Silver Bluff, Princess Anne), not alloformation. Freshwater marsh thickness OCR 'Thickness | to 40 feet.' read as 1 to 40 feet (inferred, sent to review). Symbols QHsm and QPsbs inferred from placement; QPpas from OCR 'aFpas'. Symbols for moved earth, beach sand, beach ridge sand and freshwater marsh illegible. Bodies of standing water skipped. No references on the sheet.
SUBSURFACE: page 1 has no cross section; the explanation shows SCGS drill hole symbol with example number 22-341 (logs on file at SCGS, not printed; legend only, not recorded as an observation). Terrace margins given as elevations: Holocene below 10 ft at landward margin; Silver Bluff 6-10 ft; Princess Anne 12-18 ft (page 1). Vertical datum not stated; base map OCR reads '1973 North American Datum' (Brookgreen 7.5' quadrangle, 1973), contour interval 20 feet.
Re-read of page 1 for subsurface fields (single OCR map sheet; map face is noise). Units grouped by terrace (Silver Bluff, Princess Anne) as before; map symbols read from the legend boxes on a page-image tile (OCR had them garbled, missing or placed apart). Terrace-sediment margin elevations (Holocene <10 ft landward; Silver Bluff >6/<10 ft; Princess Anne >12/<18 ft) are recorded as unit contacts and as stated unit tops at those margins (boundary inferred; no vertical datum printed). Freshwater marsh thickness OCR 'Thickness | to 40 feet.' read as 1 to 40 feet (inferred). No cross section or structure contours; SCGS drill holes (22-xxx) are plotted on the map face by label only, without depths (logs on file at SCGS), so none is recorded. Legend-only symbols and bodies of water not recorded. No references on the sheet.
